series.name: FMA Free-Match multi / TPH11 multi-split (model-scoped)
series.notes: FMA-32I4HD/DVO cassette LED table + TAC-09CHSD/TPH11 multi TROUBLE DISPLAY. E6/EF/EP meanings diverge from split inverter — never merged.

meaning.en: On TPH11 multi-split, E6 means indoor swing/vane motor fault — NOT indoor fan (fan = E6 on single-split series).
meaning.ur: TPH11 multi-split par E6 ka matlab indoor swing/vane motor fault hai — indoor fan nahi (single-split series par fan = E6).

causes.ur: Vane motor atak jaye ya disconnect ho jaye

solutions.en: Free the vane linkage
solutions.ur: Vane linkage kholein

solutions.en: Reconnect vane motor plug
solutions.ur: Vane motor ka plug dobara jor dein

solutions.en: Replace vane motor
solutions.ur: Vane motor badlein

notes.ur: Isay split-series E6 (indoor fan) ke sath na milayein. Har code ka source service_manual hai.

codes.blinkPattern: TPH11: RUN LED n/8 s per LED-code table

meaning.en: On TPH11, EP = high/low refrigerant pressure protection (vs compressor top-switch on single-split).
meaning.ur: TPH11 par EP ka matlab high/low refrigerant pressure protection hai (single-split par compressor top-switch).

solutions.en: Switch the unit off and isolate power before reading pressures.
solutions.ur: Pressure lene se pehle unit band karke power isolate karein.

solutions.en: Read the operating pressures with gauges and compare them with the manual values; low or high pressure points to charge or condenser trouble.
solutions.ur: Gauge se operating pressures parhein aur manual ki values se milayein; pressure kam ya zyada ho to gas charge ya condenser ka masla hai.

solutions.en: Repair the leak or condenser problem, recharge correctly, and replace the pressure switch only if it is stuck.
solutions.ur: Leak ya condenser ka masla theek karein, gas sahi tarah charge karein, aur pressure switch sirf atka ho to badlein.

title.ur: Outdoor vane motor ki kharabi (multi-split / cassette)

meaning.en: Outdoor swing/vane motor fault on TPH11 (vs ODU DC fan on single-split).
meaning.ur: TPH11 par outdoor swing/vane motor fault (single-split par ODU DC fan).

causes.ur: Linkage atak jaye ya rukawat pare

solutions.en: Power off the outdoor unit before checking the vane linkage.
solutions.ur: Vane linkage check karne se pehle outdoor unit band karein.

solutions.en: Inspect the linkage and connector, free anything binding and re-seat the plug; the vane should move smoothly by hand.
solutions.ur: Linkage aur connector check karein, rukawat hatayein aur plug dobara lagayein; vane ko haath se aaram se chalna chahiye.

solutions.en: Replace the swing/vane motor if it stays disconnected or does not respond.
solutions.ur: Vane motor disconnect hi rahe ya response na de to usay badlein.

title.ur: Outdoor liquid-pipe temperature sensor ki kharabi

meaning.ur: Outdoor liquid-line sensor khula/short hai.

solutions.en: Turn off power before touching the liquid-line sensor.
solutions.ur: Liquid-line sensor ko haath lagane se pehle power band karein.

solutions.en: Re-seat the connector and measure the thermistor resistance against the chart; an open or short reading means the sensor has failed.
solutions.ur: Connector dobara lagayein aur chart ke mutabiq thermistor ka resistance naapein; open/short reading aaye to sensor kharab hai.

solutions.en: Replace the sensor if the reading is still out of range.
solutions.ur: Reading ab bhi range se bahar ho to sensor badlein.

title.ur: Outdoor gas-pipe temperature sensor ki kharabi

meaning.ur: Outdoor gas-line sensor khula/short hai.

solutions.en: Isolate power before checking the gas-line sensor.
solutions.ur: Gas-line sensor check karne se pehle power band karein.

solutions.en: Re-seat the plug and test the thermistor with a meter against the manual chart.
solutions.ur: Plug dobara lagayein aur meter se manual ke chart ke mutabiq thermistor test karein.

solutions.en: Replace the sensor if it reads open or short.
solutions.ur: Open ya short parhe to sensor badlein.

meaning.en: Suction/gas-return sensor fault on FMA (TPH11: gas return sensor).
meaning.ur: FMA par suction/gas-return sensor fault (TPH11: gas return sensor).

causes.ur: Sensor open ya short ho jaye

solutions.en: Power off before removing the suction sensor.
solutions.ur: Suction sensor nikalne se pehle power band karein.

solutions.en: Re-seat the plug and check the wire for damage; a good plug should give a steady reading.
solutions.ur: Plug dobara lagayein aur wire damage ke liye check karein; plug theek ho to reading barqarar aani chahiye.

solutions.en: Measure the thermistor and replace it if it is open or short.
solutions.ur: Thermistor naapein, open ya short ho to badlein.

title.en: Indoor + outdoor EEPROM fault (multi shows both)
title.ur: Indoor + outdoor EEPROM fault (multi dono dikhata hai)

meaning.en: FMA table lists two EE rows — indoor EEPROM fault and outdoor EEPROM fault; display may show EE for either.
meaning.ur: FMA table mein EE ke do row hain — indoor EEPROM fault aur outdoor EEPROM fault; display kisi bhi ek ke liye EE dikha sakta hai.

causes.en: Corrupt or failed EEPROM on either board
causes.ur: Kisi bhi board par EEPROM kharab ya fail ho jaye

causes.en: Parameter write interrupted by power loss
causes.ur: Power cut ki wajah se parameter write adhoora ho jaye

solutions.en: Re-flash or replace the indicated board
solutions.ur: Diye gaye board ko re-flash karein ya badal dein

solutions.en: Restore correct model parameters after swap
solutions.ur: Badalne ke baad sahi model parameters wapas set karein

title.ur: Pani ke bhar jaane ki protection (condensate)

meaning.en: Drain pan float trip — condensate not pumping away (FMA shows D3; U-MATCH table shows d4 water-full).
meaning.ur: Drain pan float trip — pani bahar nahi nikal raha (FMA mein D3; U-MATCH table mein d4 water-full).

causes.ur: Drain pump kharab ho ya band ho jaye
Drain line block ho jaye ya trap chok ho jaye

solutions.en: Empty pan and clear drain line
solutions.ur: Pan khali karein aur drain line saaf karein

solutions.en: Test/replace drain pump
solutions.ur: Drain pump test karein ya badal dein

solutions.en: Free or replace float switch
solutions.ur: Float switch kholein ya badal dein

meaning.en: High-pressure switch opened (FMA/U-MATCH table) — TPH11 maps H1 to high-voltage switch instead.
meaning.ur: High-pressure switch khul gaya (FMA/U-MATCH table) — TPH11 mein H1 high-voltage switch hota hai.

causes.en: Condenser dirty/fan off causing high head pressure
causes.ur: Condenser ganda ho ya fan band ho, high head pressure ban jaye

solutions.en: Kill power
solutions.ur: Pehle power band karein

solutions.en: clean condenser and verify fan
solutions.ur: Condenser saaf karein aur fan verify karein

solutions.en: Check charge by pressures
solutions.ur: Pressure dekh kar gas charge check karein

notes.en: TPH11 p73: H1 = high voltage switch protection (electrical), H2 = low voltage switch — different from pressure meaning on FMA/U-MATCH. Per-code attribution: service_manual.
notes.ur: TPH11 p73: H1 = high voltage switch protection (electrical), H2 = low voltage switch — FMA/U-MATCH ke pressure meaning se alag hai. Har code ka source service_manual hai.

meaning.en: Low-pressure switch opened (U-MATCH table); TPH11 maps H2 to low-voltage switch.
meaning.ur: Low-pressure switch khul gaya (U-MATCH table); TPH11 mein H2 low-voltage switch hota hai.

solutions.en: Switch the unit off before checking for leaks or ice.
solutions.ur: Leak aur ice check karne se pehle unit band karein.

solutions.en: Look for ice on the suction line and leaks at the joints; ice must melt before any charging work.
solutions.ur: Suction line par ice aur joints par leak dekhein; gas bharne se pehle ice pighal jani chahiye.

solutions.en: Clear the filter restriction, then recharge to specification.
solutions.ur: Filter ki rukawat hata dein, phir specification ke mutabiq gas charge karein.

notes.en: Meaning differs by series — see H1 note. Per-code attribution: service_manual.
notes.ur: Meaning series ke sath badalti hai — H1 wala note dekhein. Har code ka source service_manual hai.

title.en: Gas leakage OR overheating in T3 (series-specific)
title.ur: Gas leakage ya T3 mein overheat protection (series ke mutabiq)

meaning.en: U-MATCH §3.3.16: H6 = gas leakage (same logic as Fy). TPH11 p73: H6 = overheating protection in T3 (outdoor pipe).
meaning.ur: U-MATCH §3.3.16 mein H6 = gas leakage hai (Fy jaisa hi logic). TPH11 p73: H6 = T3 outdoor pipe ka overheat protection hai.

solutions.en: Leak-test/recharge if U-MATCH gas-leak logic
solutions.ur: Agar U-MATCH wali gas-leak wali baat ho to leak-test kar ke gas charge karein

solutions.en: Clean condenser/fix fan if T3 overheat
solutions.ur: T3 overheat ho to condenser saaf karein aur fan theek karein

meaning.ur: Multi-split central/concert board ki EEPROM parhi nahi ja sakti.

solutions.en: Power off and isolate the board before any memory work.
solutions.ur: Memory wale kaam se pehle power band kar ke board isolate karein.

solutions.en: Power-cycle first and check whether the code clears by itself.
solutions.ur: Pehle power-cycle karein aur dekhein ke code khud clear ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Re-flash the concert PCB with the correct file or replace it, then restore the model parameters.
solutions.ur: Concert PCB ko sahi file se re-flash karein ya badal dein, phir model parameters wapas set karein.

meaning.en: Companion board EEPROM fault on multi-split.
meaning.ur: Multi-split par companion board ki EEPROM mein fault hai.

solutions.en: Turn off power before opening the companion board.
solutions.ur: Companion board kholne se pehle power band karein.

solutions.en: Power-cycle and check whether the code clears; note any power loss during parameter writes.
solutions.ur: Power-cycle karein aur code clear ho jaye to theek hai; parameter write ke doran power cut ka bhi note rakhein.

solutions.en: Replace the board and re-enter the model parameters if the fault returns.
solutions.ur: Fault wapas aaye to board badlein, phir model parameters dobara dalein.

solutions.en: Power off the outdoor unit before probing the sensor.
